sentences.text: Ekta Kapoor -LRB- born 7 June 1975 -RRB- is an Indian TV and film producer .	Indian	Indian people
She is the Joint Managing Director and Creative Director of Balaji Telefilms , her production company .	Balaji Telefilms	Balaji Telefilms
Kapoor is the daughter of actor Jeetendra and Shobha Kapoor .	Shobha Kapoor	Shobha Kapoor	Jeetendra	Jeetendra
Her younger brother Tusshar Kapoor is also a Bollywood actor .	Tusshar Kapoor	Tusshar Kapoor	Bollywood	Bollywood
She did her schooling at Bombay Scottish School , Mahim and attended college at Mithibai College .	Mithibai College	Mithibai College
She has produced numerous soap opera , television series and movies .	soap opera	soap opera	television	television

Some soap operas she had worked on include Hum Paanch , Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi , Kahaani Ghar Ghar Ki , Kasautii Zindagii Kay , Pavitra Rishta , Bade Acche Lagte Hain , and Jodha Akbar .
